{
  "coverage": [
    {"reason":"Defines private market assets and direct and indirect exposure channels.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u1.5"},
    {"reason":"Defines Funds with footnote 6 attached; disclosure and potential classification are separate consequences.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u4.564"},
    {"reason":"Risk rationale supplies no exception for comparatively safer indirect investments.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u7.1028"},
    {"reason":"Investor information and distributor selection expectations do not qualify classification.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u10.1937"},
    {"reason":"Disclosure section heading.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u11.2466"},
    {"reason":"Potential exposure triggers disclosure guidance independently of classification.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u14.2516"},
    {"reason":"Illustrative exposure disclosures do not prescribe threshold measurement or exempt senior CLO tranches.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u15.2718"},
    {"reason":"Underlying-asset disclosure examples create no credit-rating exemption.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u16.2995"},
    {"reason":"The qualification 'where appropriate' concerns KFS risk disclosure, not complex-product classification.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u17.3223"},
    {"reason":"Identifies the classification section.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u18.3743"},
    {"reason":"Establishes the inclusive threshold and separate discretionary designation route.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"},
    {"reason":"Aggregate exposure informs discretion without creating a further threshold.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u22.4078"},
    {"reason":"Fund characteristics inform discretion; favorable characteristics do not override the threshold.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u24.4176"},
    {"reason":"Instrument characteristics inform discretion; no tranche or rating exemption is stated.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u26.4290"},
    {"reason":"Home-regulator conditions are assessment factors, not independently stated exemptions.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u28.4505"},
    {"reason":"Footnote 7 attaches to the holistic designation assessment.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u29.4630"},
    {"reason":"Classification triggers prevailing sale requirements; absence of solicitation does not remove the stated suitability requirement.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u32.4805"},
    {"reason":"Target-market and distributor section heading.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u33.5086"},
    {"reason":"References separate product-approval requirements whose full content is absent.","status":"DEFERRED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u36.5149"},
    {"reason":"The qualification 'if applicable' attaches to product risk rating, not knowledge of complex-product status or classification.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u39.5617"},
    {"reason":"Advertising duties are separate from classification; full incorporated guidelines are absent.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u42.6275"},
    {"reason":"General section heading.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u43.6653"},
    {"reason":"Possible closer scrutiny and FASTrack exclusion concern authorisation processing, not classification exceptions.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u46.6668"},
    {"reason":"Existing-fund review, prompt updates and encouraged consultation do not create grandfathering or a classification grace period.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u49.6955"},
    {"reason":"Clarification contact mechanism supplies no classification fallback.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u52.7565"},
    {"reason":"Issuing division identification.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u55.7698"},
    {"reason":"Issuer identification.","status":"CONTEXT","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u56.7736"},
    {"reason":"Separate direct-investment limit does not displace combined-exposure classification; full UT Code provision remains unavailable.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u58.7778"},
    {"reason":"Exposure examples are non-exhaustive and subject to updates; omitted instrument types are not exempt.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u59.7979"},
    {"reason":"BDC description informs exposure identification without supplying a measurement method.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u60.8163"},
    {"reason":"CLO description informs exposure identification without exempting particular tranches.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u61.8338"},
    {"reason":"TRS and SRT examples identify potential indirect channels, not automatic fund classification.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u62.8487"},
    {"reason":"LAF exclusion attaches to the defined Fund scope; separate-regime treatment remains unresolved.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"},
    {"reason":"Below-50% qualification concerns holistic discretionary assessment, not an exemption from mandatory classification at or above 50%.","status":"INTERPRETED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"},
    {"reason":"Identifies sale authorities; their detailed scope and qualifications cannot be reconstructed.","status":"DEFERRED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u65.9044"},
    {"reason":"Dates and locator concern the referenced product-approval circular, not commencement of this circular; substantive dependency is absent.","status":"DEFERRED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u66.9304"},
    {"reason":"April 2013 identifies the referenced advertising guidelines in the source, not this circular's commencement; substantive dependency is absent.","status":"DEFERRED","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u67.9509"}
  ],
  "dimensions": [
    {
      "dimension":"scope",
      "explanation":"The circular addresses management companies of SFC-authorised Hong Kong public-offer Funds, excluding LAFs. The selected control determines classification triggers for one such Fund, not manager or distributor compliance.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u4.564","d4148dd852cee.u63.8691","d4148dd852cee.u32.4805"],
      "status":"PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"definitions",
      "explanation":"Private market assets comprise private credit and private equity. Both direct and indirect exposures count; examples are open-ended. Valuation, look-through, derivative measurement and aggregation conventions remain unspecified.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u1.5","d4148dd852cee.u21.3779","d4148dd852cee.u59.7979","d4148dd852cee.u60.8163","d4148dd852cee.u61.8338","d4148dd852cee.u62.8487"],
      "status":"AMBIGUOUS"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"exceptions",
      "explanation":"Footnote 6 excludes LAFs from the defined Fund scope. Footnote 7 qualifies the holistic assessment, leaving the inclusive mandatory threshold intact. KFS appropriateness, applicable risk ratings, new-fund processing and document-update timing attach to their own provisions. No supported rival attachment changes the classification rule.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u4.564","d4148dd852cee.u63.8691","d4148dd852cee.u21.3779","d4148dd852cee.u29.4630","d4148dd852cee.u64.8910","d4148dd852cee.u17.3223","d4148dd852cee.u39.5617","d4148dd852cee.u46.6668","d4148dd852cee.u49.6955"],
      "status":"PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"modality",
      "explanation":"The threshold mandates classification; the SFC may separately designate case by case. Listed factors do not compute an actual designation. Manager expectations and encouraged consultation neither suspend nor replace classification.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u21.3779","d4148dd852cee.u22.4078","d4148dd852cee.u24.4176","d4148dd852cee.u26.4290","d4148dd852cee.u28.4505","d4148dd852cee.u49.6955"],
      "status":"PROPOSED"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"time",
      "explanation":"No commencement, measurement frequency, temporary-breach treatment or persistence rule is supplied. 'As soon as practicable' concerns offering-document updates; dates in footnotes 9 and 10 concern other instruments.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u21.3779","d4148dd852cee.u49.6955","d4148dd852cee.u66.9304","d4148dd852cee.u67.9509"],
      "status":"AMBIGUOUS"
    },
    {
      "dimension":"dependencies",
      "explanation":"The LAF circular, UT Code paragraph 7.3, prevailing complex-product sale authorities, product-approval circular and advertising guidelines are referenced but not supplied substantively. The three opaque missing-dependency identifiers cannot reliably be mapped to particular authorities.",
      "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u58.7778","d4148dd852cee.u63.8691","d4148dd852cee.u65.9044","d4148dd852cee.u36.5149","d4148dd852cee.u42.6275","d4148dd852cee.u66.9304","d4148dd852cee.u67.9509"],
      "status":"AMBIGUOUS"
    }
  ],
  "questions": [
    "What applicable methodology and measurement date establish aggregate direct and indirect private-market exposure relative to NAV?",
    "What evidence establishes the Fund's public-offer authorisation, LAF status and any operative SFC designation?",
    "What governs continued classification after exposure falls below 50%, including temporary threshold crossings and removal of designation?",
    "When does this circular apply, and do any separately supplied transition provisions qualify its operation?",
    "What additional scope qualifications or requirements appear in the referenced authorities, and which authorities correspond to the three missing-dependency identifiers?"
  ],
  "readings": [
    {
      "assumptions": [
        "The circular applies at the specified assessment time; its commencement is not established by this packet.",
        "The selected control evaluates only the two stated classification routes, not exhaustive legal status or compliance with distribution duties.",
        "The threshold fact requires supported exposure measurement; disclosed investment maxima, instrument labels and rounded percentages cannot substitute for that evidence.",
        "An operative designation requires evidence of an actual SFC decision, not merely a risk factor or prospective assessment.",
        "Unknown facts remain unknown. An out-of-scope Fund receives no classification result from this control.",
        "The expression does not resolve persistence of classification arising from an earlier threshold crossing."
      ],
      "citations": [
        {"quote":"funds that are authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong (Funds)6","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u4.564"},
        {"quote":"6 Except for listed closed-ended alternative asset funds (LAFs).","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"},
        {"quote":"A Fund will be considered as a complex product if its total direct and indirect exposures to private market assets amount to 50% or more of the Fund’s NAV.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"},
        {"quote":"On a case-by-case basis, the SFC may also designate a Fund as a complex product, taking into account factors including, without limitation:","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u21.3779"},
        {"quote":"In assessing whether the complex product designation is warranted7, the SFC will adopt a holistic approach taking into account the specific circumstances of the case.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u29.4630"},
        {"quote":"In cases where the Fund’s aggregate direct and indirect exposures to private market assets are less than 50% of the Fund’s NAV.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"},
        {"quote":"in the offering documents (and where appropriate, the KFS)","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u17.3223"},
        {"quote":"to assign an appropriate product risk rating (if applicable) for the Fund","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u39.5617"},
        {"quote":"In some cases, the SFC may not process the fund under the Fund Authorisation Simple Track (FASTrack).","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u46.6668"},
        {"quote":"take appropriate actions including updating the Fund’s offering documents as soon as practicable","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u49.6955"},
        {"quote":"including but not limited to ensuring the suitability of the Fund for its investors irrespective of whether solicitation or recommendation is involved.","unit_id":"d4148dd852cee.u32.4805"}
      ],
      "distinction":"The exception-attachment challenge supports retaining the parent's rule. Attaching the LAF exclusion only to disclosure fails because footnote 6 appears at the Fund definition. Treating footnote 7 as a below-50% safe harbour or as discretion to waive the threshold fails because it attaches to holistic assessment, while the preceding threshold sentence is unqualified. Extending KFS appropriateness, applicable risk ratings, FASTrack discretion or document-update timing to classification likewise lacks textual support. These failed hypotheses do not justify a competing formal rule. The strongest unresolved issue is temporal persistence: absence of both current routes does not establish that an earlier classification has ceased.",
      "family":"exceptions",
      "formalization":{
        "facts":[
          {
            "meaning":"Whether the assessed fund is authorised by the SFC for offering to the public in Hong Kong at the assessment time.",
            "name":"public_sfc_authorised",
            "requires_judgment":false,
            "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u4.564"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"Boolean"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"Whether the assessed fund is a listed closed-ended alternative asset fund within the footnote 6 exclusion.",
            "name":"is_laf",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u63.8691"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"Boolean"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"Whether the Fund's total direct and indirect exposure to private market assets amounts to at least 50% of its NAV at the assessment time, using the applicable methodology. Missing or unresolved measurement evidence leaves this fact unknown.",
            "name":"aggregate_exposure_at_least_half_nav",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u1.5","d4148dd852cee.u21.3779","d4148dd852cee.u59.7979"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"Boolean"
          },
          {
            "meaning":"Whether an SFC case-by-case designation of this Fund as a complex product under this circular is operative at the assessment time. Mere designation risk or missing records does not establish either truth value.",
            "name":"operative_sfc_designation",
            "requires_judgment":true,
            "source_unit_ids":["d4148dd852cee.u21.3779","d4148dd852cee.u29.4630","d4148dd852cee.u64.8910"],
            "type":"bool",
            "unit":"Boolean"
          }
        ],
        "result":"(or aggregate_exposure_at_least_half_nav operative_sfc_designation)",
        "result_type":"bool",
        "scope":"(and public_sfc_authorised (not is_laf))"
      },
      "local_id":"classification_routes_exception_attachment",
      "questions":[
        "Does a prior threshold-based classification persist after exposure falls below 50%, independently of an operative discretionary designation?",
        "What exposure methodology and operative designation evidence permit evaluation at the selected time?",
        "What separate treatment applies to LAFs under the absent referenced circular?"
      ],
      "statement":"[TRUE_IS_SATISFIED] Selected control: whether either stated classification route is satisfied for an in-scope Fund at the assessment time. True means combined direct and indirect private-market exposure is at least 50% of NAV, including exactly 50%, or an operative SFC case-by-case designation exists; the Fund must consequently be treated as complex under this reading. False means both specified routes are affirmatively absent at that time. It does not establish non-complex status, cessation of historical classification, compliance with sale requirements or an exemption under another instrument. Missing evidence does not supply a false fact.",
      "subject":"Attachment of exclusions and qualifications to the circular's complex-product classification routes"
    }
  ]
}
